title: 10 Days After Fiance's Murder, Siya Goyal, Chetan Chaudhary Taken To Pune Fort To Recreate Crime Scene
description: The exercise forms part of the ongoing investigation into the June 18 incident, in which Ketan Agarwal, 26, was allegedly pushed off the fort by Siya Goyal, 20, and her alleged lover, Chetan Chaudhary, 22.
